question: What proportion of fire offerings with palāśa flowers is prescribed?
premises: Fire offerings are to be made with palāśa flowers.
A tenth part is specified as an option.
A hundredth part is specified as an alternative.
inference: One should offer palāśa flowers in fire as a tenth part or a hundredth part.
uncertainties: The base quantity to which the fraction applies is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: One should make fire offerings with palāśa flowers, either a tenth part or a hundredth part.
